title: Deterministic reservation of untouched final seeds
purpose: Select and register new final model seeds only after the complete Task 63 protocol freeze, using a deterministic outcome-free procedure and a repository-wide prior-usage audit.

seed_policy.acceptance_rule: Accept the earliest candidate indices whose derived integer is unique, is not a development seed, and has zero exact numeric-token usage hits in the pre-Task64 repository corpus.
seed_policy.numeric_token_definition: candidate seed delimited by non-digits or string boundaries
seed_policy.conservative_collision_policy: Any exact numeric-token occurrence in the audited prior corpus rejects that candidate even if the occurrence may be unrelated to random seeding.

prior_usage_audit.scope: Repository filesystem present at Task64 execution, excluding Task64 files, virtual environments, Git internals, caches, and reserved-test paths.

exit_gates: Task63 parent tag resolves and is an ancestor of current HEAD
exactly five final seeds are selected
no final seed is one of 7, 42, 99, 123, or 2026
selection is deterministic from the frozen namespace and prior-usage rule
all selected seeds have zero prior-usage hits
no unreadable eligible prior text files remain
no reserved test array path is opened
no training, SHAP evaluation, or LLM call occurs
